source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The comm wrapper resolves a key handle, obtains its revocation signature and reads separate code and text buffers. Missing handles return a null pair. Normal completion frees the buffers, signature and key. A throw in nested extraction bypasses later destructor calls because the new wrappers have no finally. This describes the inspected control flow, not a reproduced native leak or an ABI guarantee.
title: Key revocation reason extraction has distinct missing, success and exception cleanup paths
